Done! I've added the `uniqueIds(ids)` function to `src/importer.js`. It:
- Takes an array of ids
- Uses a Set to track which ids have already been seen
- Filters to keep only the first occurrence of each id
- Maintains the original order of first-seen ids
- Is exported for use in other modules

The function efficiently removes duplicates in linear time while preserving insertion order.
